content.title: Open the contact page and review the published support details
content.intent: Prove the contact page presents the heading, support hours, and phone number an author needs before contacting support.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to separate the page's static support-details promise from its route-back-to-submissions promise. Negative, boundary, auth, and state-flow techniques were not applicable because the cited source specifies no input, failure mode, access gate, or multi-step state transition. Budget ceiling is 3 pairs; this scenario was kept because all 2 candidate scenarios fit within budget.
